Cardinality.snippet: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cardinality FROM events;
Cardinality.symptom: Bad join strategy because NDV was underestimated.

Granularity (Grain).snippet:
-- State grain before modeling:
-- one row per order_id + product_id (line item)
Granularity (Grain).symptom: Revenue doubles after joining order headers to line items.

Grain.snippet:
-- Fact grain: 1 row = 1 completed checkout
-- Always declare grain before designing the fact
Grain.symptom: KPI doesn't match finance because grains differ.

Predicate Pushdown.snippet:
df = spark.read.parquet("s3://lake/events").filter("dt = '2024-01-01'")
# filter pushed into scan / partition prune
Predicate Pushdown.symptom: Full scan of years of data for a one-day query.

Partition Pruning.snippet:
SELECT * FROM sales WHERE dt BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-07';
-- only those partitions are read
Partition Pruning.symptom: Query reads every partition folder despite a date filter.

Shuffle.snippet:
df.groupBy("user_id").count()  # wide transform → shuffle
# Spark UI: Shuffle Read/Write bytes
Shuffle.symptom: Stage stuck; network/disk dominated by shuffle.

Job → Stage → Task.snippet:
# action → job; shuffle boundary → stage; partition → task
df.write.parquet(path)  # triggers a job
Job → Stage → Task.symptom: Confused debugging — looking at tasks without finding the slow stage.

Lazy Evaluation.snippet:
f = df.filter(...).select(...)  # builds plan only
f.count()                     # action runs the job
Lazy Evaluation.symptom: Thinking transforms already ran; surprise cost on first action.

Wide vs Narrow Transformations.symptom: Extra wide transforms inflate runtime for little gain.

Adaptive Query Execution (AQE).symptom: Static plan picks sort-merge when broadcast would win.

Catalyst Optimizer.symptom: Python UDF blocks optimizations → slower than SQL expr.

Broadcast Join.symptom: Shuffling a tiny dimension across the cluster.

Sort Merge Join.snippet:
# default large-large join after shuffle+sort
big.join(other_big, "user_id")
Sort Merge Join.symptom: Join spills to disk; one key's partition is huge.

Data Skew.snippet:
df.groupBy("key").count().orderBy(desc("count")).show(20)
# then salt hot keys or enable AQE skew join
Data Skew.symptom: One task runs 10× longer than the rest of the stage.

Small File Problem.snippet:
df.coalesce(64).write.mode("overwrite").parquet(path)
# or OPTIMIZE / compaction on lakehouse tables
Small File Problem.symptom: Driver spends ages listing; thousands of tiny tasks.

Conformed Dimension.snippet: -- same customer_key + attributes shared by sales & support facts
Conformed Dimension.symptom: Two marts define "customer" differently; dashboards disagree.

Delta Lake.symptom: Concurrent jobs overwrite parquet folders; readers see partial data.

Time Travel.snippet:
SELECT * FROM orders VERSION AS OF 120;
-- or TIMESTAMP AS OF '2024-06-01'
Time Travel.symptom: Can't reproduce yesterday's report after a bad overwrite.

Schema Evolution.symptom: Producer adds a column; downstream jobs break or ignore it silently.

CAP Theorem.snippet:
# In a partition: choose Consistency or Availability
# Document the tradeoff for your store/queue
CAP Theorem.symptom: Expecting strong reads from an AP system during a region blip.

Event Time.symptom: Hourly metrics shift when late mobile events arrive.

Watermarks.snippet:
.withWatermark("event_time", "15 minutes")
# closes windows; late data policy after this
Watermarks.symptom: State grows forever, or late events are dropped too aggressively.

Exactly Once.snippet:
# Need checkpointing + idempotent/transactional sink
query = df.writeStream.option("checkpointLocation", ckpt).foreachBatch(...)
Exactly Once.symptom: Duplicates after restart even though processing "felt" safe.

At Least Once.snippet:
# retries may re-send — make sink upsert/idempotent
# ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE ...
At Least Once.symptom: Counts inflate after every pipeline retry.

Idempotency.snippet:
# overwrite a partition instead of blind append
df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("dt").parquet(path)
Idempotency.symptom: Re-running a failed day duplicates rows in the target.

Checkpointing.symptom: Streaming job reprocesses from earliest offsets after path loss.

Dead Letter Queue (DLQ).symptom: One poison message blocks the whole consumer group.

Data Contracts.snippet:
# CI: fail PR if producer schema breaks consumer contract
# enforce required fields + types at write boundary
Data Contracts.symptom: Silent column rename breaks 12 downstream jobs overnight.

Data Lineage.snippet:
# raw.orders → stg_orders → fct_orders → BI KPI
# track table + column lineage in the catalog
Data Lineage.symptom: Can't tell which dashboard breaks if a source column is dropped.

Freshness.snippet:
SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM fct_orders;
-- alert if now() - max_updated_at > SLA
Freshness.symptom: Job is green but data is 18 hours stale.

Object Storage.snippet:
s3://lake/bronze/events/dt=2024-01-01/part-000.parquet
# lake tables live as objects + metadata
Object Storage.symptom: Treating S3 like a local FS; millions of tiny LIST requests.

Explain Plan.symptom: Tuning blindly without reading the plan.

Salting.snippet:
hot = df.withColumn("salt", (rand()*N).cast("int"))
# join on key+salt, then drop salt
Salting.symptom: AQE still leaves one monstrous partition on a hot key.

Compaction.symptom: Reads degrade daily as streaming adds tiny files.

Z-Ordering.symptom: Selective filters on non-partition columns still scan everything.

Circuit Breaker.snippet: # after N failures → open circuit → fail fast → half-open probe
Circuit Breaker.symptom: Retries hammer a down warehouse and cascade timeouts.

Caching.snippet:
df.cache()
df.count()  # materialize
# ... reuse df ...
df.unpersist()
Caching.symptom: Same expensive subtree recomputed on every action.

IAM.snippet: # job role: s3:GetObject on bronze/*, PutObject on silver/* only
IAM.symptom: Long-lived access keys leaked from a notebook.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC).snippet:
terraform plan && terraform apply
# buckets, IAM, warehouses versioned in Git
Infrastructure as Code (IaC).symptom: Prod lake config drifts from staging; only one person knows clicks.

Event Sourcing.snippet: # append OrderPlaced, ItemAdded... rebuild state by replay
Event Sourcing.symptom: Overwriting current state and losing audit history.

BASE.snippet: # Basically Available, Soft state, Eventually consistent
BASE.symptom: Applying strict ACID expectations to a geo-replicated cache.
